reference.scope: Same synthetic affine function, same native numerical consumption; existing variable-font mechanism

methodology.formula: S = sum_i (variant.weights[i] * x_i); y = 2*S + 1; x_i integers [-8,7]. Standard weights repeat [3,-2,5,1]; fanout effective weights [9,1,6,5].
methodology.oracle: Independent arithmetic in external Node driver; browser receives only raw inputs and nonce, never an answer or product
methodology.nativePath: CSS signed input properties -> CSS counters -> GSUB product/reduction/dependent/publish -> glyph advance -> CSS anchor-size/container units -> decoded numeric y -> width(consumerOffset + 3*y)
methodology.hvarControlPath: For kind:hvar only: raw CSS input properties -> variable-font axes -> one HVAR advance for affine y (weights folded) -> same anchor/container reader and dependent width consumer. This control has no internal GSUB reduction or continuation.
methodology.directCssPath: Same input properties -> direct CSS calc weighted sum and dependent expression -> width(consumerOffset + 3*y); no font/anchor/container return trip
methodology.timedRegion: Raw input and nonce style writes through forced final dependent width reads, including JavaScript mutation/read loop overhead; stimulus generation, oracle, CDP transport and font loading excluded
methodology.order: Alternates GSUB-first and direct-CSS-first each sample; 40 samples, first5 warmups excluded
methodology.cachePhases: stable-nonce uses nonce0 while inputs change; unique-text changes a zero-advance nonce each round. The latter prevents identical full text reuse, not all internal font caches.
methodology.scope: Synthetic signed integer weighted sums and affine continuation; not GPT-2 inference or a full model speedup
